claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18500 1100mAh 10A as a 1100mAh preset with a 10A runtime rating.
HKJ's Efest IMR 18500 1100mAh review records a red-wrapper V1 revision as flat-top and a V2 revision as button-top, with observed dimensions of approximately 18.10 mm x 50.93 mm.

The Efest IMR 18500 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 18500 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-04-26 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: Two historical red Efest 18500 1100mAh revisions are documented, but the catalog entry does not identify the revision or underlying OEM cell.
checks: Identify whether the cell matches the V1 flat-top or V2 button-top red wrapper before applying the corresponding fit details.
Inspect label layout, wrapper, and terminal against a known-good sample.
Do not infer the underlying OEM cell from Efest branding alone.
